Name: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018)
Description: The Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018) were developed by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) to set minimum cybersecurity requirements for national organizations to protect information assets and technology infrastructure against cyber threats.

Requirements.Name: 1-1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy & Governance
Requirements.Description: A cybersecurity strategy must be defined, approved by management, and aligned with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.

Requirements.Name: 1-4-1 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities must be clearly defined, assigned to authorized personnel, and segregated to avoid conflict of interest.

Requirements.Name: 1-5-1 Cybersecurity Risk Management
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity risks must be continuously identified, analyzed, evaluated, and treated using automated threat intelligence and vulnerability management.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-1 Asset Management & Inventory
Requirements.Description: An accurate and up-to-date inventory of all technology assets and cloud resources must be maintained and protected.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-1 Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Requirements.Description: Access to systems and data must be controlled through unique identification, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and least-privilege role assignment.

Requirements.Name: 2-3-1 Information System Protection & Hardening
Requirements.Description: Workloads and virtual infrastructure must be hardened with endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, and secure baseline configurations.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-1 Network Security Management
Requirements.Description: Network perimeters, VPCs, and subnets must be segmented and protected using Security Groups, Network ACLs, and VPC Flow Logs.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-1 Data and Information Protection
Requirements.Description: Data at rest and in transit must be protected against unauthorized disclosure, modification, and deletion.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-1 Cryptography and Key Management
Requirements.Description: Cryptographic keys, certificates, and secrets must be managed securely through AWS KMS with automatic rotation and deletion protection.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-1 Backup and Recovery Management
Requirements.Description: Automated backups of critical workloads and databases must be configured, encrypted, tested periodically, and protected.

Requirements.Name: 2-12-1 Event Logs and Monitoring Management
Requirements.Description: Security event logs, CloudTrail audit trails, and VPC flow logs must be centralized, encrypted, and retained for security investigations.

Requirements.Name: 2-15-1 Web Application Security
Requirements.Description: Web applications and APIs must enforce HTTPS with strong TLS ciphers, WAF rate-limiting, and client certificate verification.
